note: c7: 神明崎 (五十鈴神社, 猪狩神社, 浮見堂), the コの字岸壁 quay of 魚町, and 港町 below the 気仙沼プラザホテル down to JFみやぎ; east of x 600 is open water. Read from Google Earth 3D (imagery 2026-03-11) in raw/ref/earth/c7 (the whole cell in full_before/, sub-cells sub-n and sub-s with top, four 60-degree and two low obliques each), checked against the GSI photo (raw/ref/earth/c7/gsi_*.jpg) and OSM. Roof colours are the Earth readings lifted by a neutral gain of 1.17 (Earth renders darker than the GSI photo the town is coloured from: GSI/Earth 1.15-1.32 on unchanged roofs and paving here).
